versions.changelog: Improve skill packaging and publishing workflow; refine browser fallback support and documentation.

- Initial release of Clawnoter Obsidian Saving skill.
- Save web articles to local Obsidian Vault, with support for image extraction, Markdown conversion, YAML frontmatter, and user notes.
- Guided first-time setup for specifying and validating Obsidian Vault save path (supports local and iCloud).
- Dual content extraction: First tries Jina.ai Reader; if that fails, falls back to local HTML to Markdown conversion.
- Integrated workflow to download images, generate clean notes, and save all content to the configured Vault location.
- Includes clear formats, error handling, and flexible reconfiguration commands for an easy user experience.
